evidence.title: flightcn — Beautiful Flight Visualizations for React
Flight Map Components for React | flightcn

name: flightcn
summary: Flight visualization components for React with prebuilt map blocks, installed from a shadcn registry.
description: A shadcn registry of flight and satellite visualization components for React, built on MapLibre and the mapcn ecosystem. Flight pieces cover airport markers, single and multi-leg great-circle routes, live trackers, aircraft trails, route networks, range rings and traffic flow; satellite pieces render animated orbit overlays on a globe. It also ships prebuilt blocks like Flight Ops Overview, Flight Tracker Dashboard, Flight Route Picker and Departures Board, a built-in 500+ airport database, live playgrounds and API props tables.
contains: 13 installable registry items: components, playgrounds and blocks
10 flight components: FlightAirport, FlightRoute, FlightTracker, FlightNetwork, FlightRange, FlightFlow and more
11 prebuilt blocks incl. Flight Ops Overview and Departures Board
built-in 500+ airport database with code, city and country search
